source.author: lucan
source.text: Tu, nova ne veteres obscurent facta triumphos, Et victis cedat piratica laurea Gallis, Magne, times: te iam series ususque laborum Erigit, impatiensque loci fortuna secundi.
source.text_original: Tu, nova ne veteres obscurent facta triumphos, / Et victis cedat piratica laurea Gallis, / Magne, times: te iam series ususque laborum / Erigit, impatiensque loci fortuna secundi.
source.text_english: You, great one, fear lest your new achievements eclipse your former triumphs, and lest the pirate’s laurel yield to the conquered Gauls; but the succession and long practice of your labors now raise you up, and fortune, impatient of a second place, too, has emboldened you.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hanc mihi militiam, veterum quae pulchrior actis, adnue daque animum.
reuse.text_original: 'hanc mihi militiam, veterum quae pulchrior actis, / adnue daque animum.
reuse.text_english: Grant me this service, more splendid than the deeds of old, and give me courage.
